thread:
Sara: quick heads-up, seeing a perf regression in runtime 3.4.0 with quantized llama3x on long sequences :eyes:
Tom: repro/diff? logs?
Sara: small repro in canary: tail latency spikes ~2x after 1k tokens, KV cache pressure looks fine. attaching telemetry link in a bit
Maya: posted telemetry -> https://internal.telemetry/redwood/trace/abc123 : looks like a newly selected kernel path on aarch64 for quant ops
Tom: if it's kernel selection, we should pin runtime back to 3.3.5 for affected models/regions until patch. Can we do a short emergency pin window?
Lee: what's the blast radius? only llama3x-quant or more models?
Maya: confirmed for llama3x-quant variants and mixed-precision v2 only. non-quant and older quant variants unaffected. region: eu-west-1 first, maybe us-west-2 after canary.
Sara: propose: short pin of runtime=3.3.5 for model=llama3x-quant in eu-west-1 for 2h while R&D lands kernel fix. Rollback policy: automatic unpin if error-rate <0.5% and p95 latency back to baseline; otherwise manual escalation.
Tom: +1. Let's canary 10% of traffic first for 15m then roll to 100% of eu-west-1 if stable. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, generation errors, queue depth.
Lee: add a runaway safeguard: if generation errors > 1% for 5m then force-fallback to runtime 3.3.5 globally for that model.
Sara: agreed. I'll open the release-note blurb and schedule the pin.
Tom: also add a note to SDK compat matrix that runtime 3.4.0 has known perf risk for quantized llama3x longseqs until patch.
Sara: deploy-bot, please schedule emergency pin for eu-west-1 starting now. Command: `/deploybot pin runtime=3.3.5 model=llama3x-quant region=eu-west-1 window=2h reason="kernel-regression-canary"`
deploy-bot: scheduling pin: runtime=3.3.5 model=llama3x-quant region=eu-west-1 window=2h initiated_by=Sara at=1716754330 :white_check_mark:
Maya: I'll monitor telemetry and post an update at +15m and +60m.
Lee: I'll add the rollback runbook and notify CS & oncall.
Tom: thanks, team. keep short updates here. :thumbsup:
Sara: quick note for release notes: "Temporary runtime pin for llama3x-quant in eu-west-1 due to observed audio/longseq kernel regression in runtime 3.4.0. Customers routed to 3.3.5 until fix is rolled out."
